question: Why cannot a Van de Graaff generator build up infinite potential on its spherical shell?

options.A: Because the belt stops moving due to friction.
options.B: Because the electric field around the sphere eventually exceeds the dielectric strength of air (approx. $3 \times 10^6$ V/m), causing corona discharge (breakdown).
options.C: Because the motor runs out of power.
options.D: Because the inner sphere runs out of charge.
